summary: Generation Income Properties filed an 8-K disclosing a September 18, 2026 warrant inducement letter with an existing holder of warrants issued in its June 1, 2026 registered offering. The holder agreed to cash-exercise existing warrants for up to 4,074,359 shares at a reduced $1.05 per share, versus the prior $1.17 exercise price, in exchange for new unregistered five-year warrants covering 8,148,718 shares (200% of existing warrant shares) at $1.05. New warrants require stockholder approval before exercise; resale registration is due within 30 days after approval. Watch approval timing, cash proceeds, dilution, and a 4.99% beneficial-ownership blocker limiting exercise.
